description: Groz steel bench vice is an ideal solution for all sort of heavy duty use including hammering, chipping, shaping, beating and other tough applications. It has excellent shock bearing capacity and high strength under compression making it a perfect fit for rugged use. It comes with jaws which are hardened to 45± 5 HRC providing excellent wear resistance. Smartly designed front jaw beam which fully encloses vice spindle protects threads from contaminants & damage preventing frequent maintenance. Attractive powder coated finish vice body with main screw and handle chrome plated makes it least prone to scratches, wear and chipping.
